author: IGN
description:
An intoxicating mix of madness and sweet is coming to HIDIVE. MURCIÉLAGO premieres soon on HIDIVE.

MURCIÉLAGO follows the story of Kuroko Koumori, former death-row inmate turned state-appointed officially sanctioned executioner, and her partner Hinako Tozakura, an innocent-looking girl with extraordinary driving skills. Together, they are a deranged yet unbeatable duo, confronting the darkness lurking within society. This thrilling and uncompromising story has earned a passionate fanbase both in Japan and around the world.

#IGN #Anime
title: MURCIÉLAGO - Official Teaser Trailer

author: IGN
description:
Don't miss the 'Meet Haymitch' Featurette for The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping, an upcoming film starring Joseph Zada, Jesse Plemons, Ralph Fiennes, Glenn Close, Kieran Culkin, Elle Fanning, Mckenna Grace, Maya Hawke, Whitney Peak, and Kelvin Harrison Jr. Get the rundown on Joseph Zada's journey on portraying Haymitch in The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping, in theaters on November 20.

The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping will revisit the world of Panem twenty-four years before the events of The Hunger Games, starting on the morning of the reaping of the Fiftieth Hunger Games, also known as the Second Quarter Quell. 

The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping screenplay is by Billy Ray. It is based on the novel by Suzanne Collins. It is produced by Nina Jacobson, Brad Simpson, and Francis Lawrence.

The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping, directed by Francis Lawrence, opens in theaters on November 20, 2026.

#TheHungerGamesSunriseOfTheReaping #Movies #IGN
title: The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping - Official 'Meet Haymitch' Featurette (2026) Joseph Zada

author: IGN
description:
Can you master all four elements? We played Avatar Legends: The Fighting Game at AX 2026. We're checking out the roster, character abilities, and the game's unique mechanics and story mode. Then, we chat with the developers about what to expect when the game launches July 23rd on PC, PS5, Xbox, and Nintendo Switch. 

Avatar Legends: The Fighting Game lets you play as your favorite Avatar characters, including Aang, Korra, Zuko, Katara, Sokka, Toph, Azula, Kyoshi, and more. The game also features an original story mode written by Tim Hedrick and outlined by Michael Dante DiMartino, competitive rollback netcode, and hand-animated visuals. 

Presented by Avatar Legends: The Fighting Game

#AvatarLegendsTheFightingGame #Gaming #IGN
title: We Played Avatar Legends: The Fighting Game at Anime Expo 2026

author: IGN
description: Since hitting early access in 2024, Palworld has drastically evolved far beyond its origins as "Pokemon with guns." From massive island expansions like Sakurajima and Feybreak to the incredible Tides of Terraria crossover event, developer Pocketpair has constantly added new Pals, challenging endgame raids, and major quality-of-life improvements. Now, as the survival-crafting hit officially exits Early Access and drops its massive Version 1.0 update on July 10, 2026, we are taking a comprehensive look back at everything that has been added to make the game a chaotic, ambitious masterpiece.
title: Palworld: Everything Major Added Since Launch
